name: Vansen LumiStride Jogger
description: A tapered jogger in charcoal with a single wide transparent biopolymer panel running down each outer thigh — designed for bioluminescent geneware users who want to move freely without hiding their mods. The rest of the fabric is a soft four-way stretch. Elastic cuffs, hidden waistband drawstring. Popular with people who run or cycle, and with people who just like the look.
functionality: Outer thigh transparent panels display bioluminescent geneware during movement; four-way stretch for full range of motion
what_it_says: You're active, you've got bioluminescence, and you've stopped dressing like you need to apologize for it.
story_hooks: At night the transparent panels turn the wearer into an inadvertent beacon — useful or dangerous depending on who's watching.
A character's panels are cracked down the center of one leg, dimming the glow on that side — they haven't had it fixed yet.

physical_description.visual_profile: Sleek tapered jogger with a distinctly futuristic silhouette. The charcoal base creates a minimalist foundation, while dual transparent biopolymer panels down the outer thighs create a 'display window' effect — perfect for showcasing integrated bioluminescent modifications. The overall impression is tech-forward and intentionally transparent about enhancement.
physical_description.fit: Tapered through hip and thigh, with a relaxed drop-crotch typical of jogger construction. Four-way stretch provides mobility for running or cycling. Fitted elastic cuffs at the ankle create clean definition. Waistband sits naturally with integrated drawstring for adjustment.
physical_description.primary_material: Soft four-way stretch synth-blend base (likely polyamide/spandex composite). Transparent biopolymer panels are flexible, optically clear, and durable for daily flex.
physical_description.texture: Base fabric has a smooth, almost buttery surface with slight sheen from the synthetic weave. Biopolymer panels are glossy and glass-like, creating visual contrast. Slight knit texture visible in the stretch material.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep charcoal gray base with crystal-clear transparent biopolymer panels. The contrast allows any bioluminescent mods beneath to glow unobstructed — neon blues, cyans, and purples would be striking against the dark base.
physical_description.closures: Hidden waistband drawstring (friction-fit pull mechanism). Elastic ankle cuffs with no visible fasteners.
distinctive_features: Dual transparent biopolymer thigh panels designed as 'mod windows'
Tapered silhouette with clean ankle definition
Strategic transparency as design philosophy, not concealment
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 crossover — premium construction and design innovation at accessible price point. High enough quality to indicate corpo-adjacent lifestyle, but marketed to active working-class users with visible mods.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by bioluminescent geneware enthusiasts, runners, cyclists, and the 'augment-proud' demographic. Signals comfort with body modification and a tech-forward mentality. Popular in GLMZ's younger professional and athletic communities.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to lightly worn. The biopolymer panels develop minor micro-scratches with use but rarely fully degrade. The charcoal base hides wear well; elastic cuffs maintain shape through repeated wear.
